items.title: Maude Johnson Interview, 1959-01-06
items.q: he was playing a bass horn, one of the school's bass horn with Gus Fontaine.

ctx.x: Did he seem to be unhappy when he couldn't play music without it or was he just resigned to it? Or did he seem to mind it much that he didn't play anymore and miss it a lot?
Well, I think he didn't miss it. Cause he used to, cause then after that, before he got a horn, he was playing a bass horn, one of the school's bass horn with Gus Fontaine.
He would be on bass. Before he had his false teeth or even or not? Did he do anything at all when he?
